_comment: academic-writing scaffold -- EXAMPLE config (a template to adapt, not a live
config). Copy the models block into your own config (~/.jichi or
local/config.json) and fill in your provider/model/apiBase. Secret-free:
the key comes from an env var named by apiKeyEnv, never a literal key here.
A capable chat model is all you need. Point at a local model (LM Studio /
llama.cpp / Ollama) or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; see docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md.
This bench COACHES your writing; it does not write your paper. You are
responsible for academic integrity -- cite sources and follow your
institution's rules on AI assistance. See skills/academic-integrity.
snapshots let you /undo an edit; pathFence keeps writes in this workspace.
